name: What kitchen finishes are most appealing to Bay Area homebuyers?

mainEntity.name: What kitchen finishes are most appealing to Bay Area homebuyers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bay Area homebuyers generally favor clean, contemporary, and durable kitchen finishes. Popular choices include quartz or granite countertops, shaker-style cabinetry in neutral tones (white, grey, light wood), and stainless steel appliances. Hardwood or large format tile flooring is also highly regarded. These choices offer a versatile foundation that allows new owners to easily personalize with decor, appealing to a broader market segment.
